planets.name: TOI-776 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-776 with a 15.7-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-776 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-776. Its orbit and size follow Fridlund et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
